cluster.description: The Plural cluster handle identifying which cluster to query

operation.description: How to update the resource. Use replace to PUT the full desired resource definition. Use apply to perform Kubernetes server-side apply for only the fields present in the provided resource, with Plural as the field manager

group.description: The kubernetes API group (e.g. apps, networking.k8s.io). Use an empty string for the core API group

version.description: The kubernetes API version for this resource within the group (e.g. v1)

namespace.description: the kubernetes namespace this resource is in, ignore if this is a cluster scoped resource

json.description: The JSON resource definition to send to kubernetes. For replace this should be the full desired resource. For apply this may contain only the fields to manage via server-side apply. The status field is ignored

explanation.description: Clearly explain why this update is needed, what it will change, and the target resource so the user can make an informed approval decision
